native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original groups only; full suite not run

findings: Exact substring scanning accepts compact assistant record but ignores JSON-equivalent spacing after type colon. isSidechain colon spacing causes sidechain record to be counted as main record. These are valid synthetic JSON records; actual host serialization variations not established.

measure_agent_usage_in does not restrict record type and counts a valid synthetic user usage block. Repeated identical records are summed twice; whether actual host repeats billable records is unqualified.

A valid600000-character-content assistant record with usage near beginning gives10 tokens through in-memory scan butNone through512KiB-tail file scan. Size assumption is not a guaranteed parser boundary.

detect_window misses a newer identity record in the unscanned middle of an owned1.2MiB transcript and returns old1M head identity after switch to standard. Valid file records independently parsed using Python JSON.
Agent spawn and future reread costs remain estimates; source uses max(observed context,cache read)*4 floor and separate burst constant. No actual agents spawned or cost accuracy qualified.
transfer_decision: Use structural JSON parsing and explicit record boundaries for persisted identity/accounting. Bounded scans must expose insufficient coverage instead of silently asserting latest state. No foreign production code copied.
